total_model.summary: Model projects 49.6 total points (DET 26, CHI 24). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 1.5), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 1.1), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 0.9). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
